name: HK Electric Investments and HK Electric Investments Limited
summary: HK Electric Investments and HK Electric Investments Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the generation, transmission, distribution, and supply of electricity in Hong Kong Island and Lamma Island. The company operates coal-fired units, gas turbines and standby units, gas-fired combined-cycle units, solar power system, and wind turbine with an installed capacity of 3,083 megawatts. It also operated a transmission and distribution network of 7,143 kilometers, as well as served 599,000 residential, commercial, and industrial customers.
